Last month, I had the opportunity to intern at New Green Power 永鑫能源 in Taipei, a leading renewable energy developer in Taiwan backed by Global Infrastructure Partner / Blackrock. As part of the investment team, I gained valuable exposure to how renewable energy projects are evaluated, financed, and developed from early-stage planning through operations. During my internship, I was involved in various investment-related tasks, including: - Conducting renewable energy market research for investment teaser - Supporting a new facility set up for a project finance, covering financial model sensitive analysis, IM preparation - Assisting with IC memo, including industry research, financial analysis, and project updates. - Reviewing commercial agreements and project documents to better understand transaction structures. One of my biggest takeaways was learning how different functions, including investment, engineering, legal, and operations teams, collaborate to successfully deliver renewable energy projects. I would like to sincerely thank everyone at New Green Power, especially Allen Hsueh , for the guidance and support throughout my internship. This experience strengthened my understanding of infrastructure investment and renewable energy, and further motivated me to continue exploring opportunities in finance and the energy sector.

Executive Summary: Thank You Context Ventures 2026 Summer Analysts 1/ I’d like to recognize and thank our fantastic team of Summer Analysts. Our analysts became an integral part of the Context VC team this summer. They conducted due diligence on investment opportunities, analyzed market and AI adoption trends, and did deep research beyond just using AI on deeptech, drones, national labs, and more. They also provided feedback & new perspectives on founder pitch meetings. They helped manage deal flow, supported portfolio companies, attended events, contributed to our social media, and kept us organized across several projects. 2/ All four high school analysts are Sacred Heart Cathedral Preparatory (SHC) students or alums, and we're especially excited to celebrate what's next for each of them: 🎓 Martin Levy is a recent graduate of SHC, and he is currently preparing for his next academic chapter. During his time at SHC, he demonstrated significant leadership as the president of the Finance Club, where he served as the lead speaker and played a pivotal role in organizing meetings and driving the club's growth. Marty will attend Loyola University Chicago to study finance and minor in economics in the fall. 📊 Michael Elsbernd is a rising senior, and he is a member of the varsity golf team, the California Scholarship Federation, and several other student organizations. He is especially interested in finance, mathematics, community service, and quantitative research. Michael has developed a range of projects in quantitative finance and has recently pursued independent mathematical research related to the Riemann Hypothesis and the Navier–Stokes equations. 📈 Henry Dougherty is a rising junior with a strong passion for finance. As co-president of the Finance Club, he is dedicated to promoting financial literacy, helping students deepen their understanding of markets and personal finance. Henry has demonstrated proactive leadership by organizing speaker events featuring industry leaders, such as a CFO from a public fintech company, and plans to expand the series further. Beyond his leadership in finance, Henry is an active member of SHC’s varsity speech and debate team and a dedicated member of the lacrosse team. 💼 Brett Berthiaume is also a rising junior with a strong passion for finance and investing. As co-president of the Finance Club, he is committed to promoting financial literacy and helping students develop a stronger understanding of investing and personal finance. Brett is also a member of SHC’s varsity speech and debate team, competing at both the state and national levels, where he has developed exceptional public speaking and critical thinking skills. He is also a captain of the lacrosse team. 3/ Thank you, Marty, Henry, Brett, and Michael, for all your hard work this summer. We really appreciated having you on the team and are excited to follow your future successes. We will be rooting and celebrating all of your future successes!

honors_and_awards.title: AP Scholar with Distinction
honors_and_awards.description: Every fall, the AP Program recognizes high school students who have demonstrated outstanding college-level achievement through their performance on multiple AP Exams. The AP Scholar with Distinction Award is granted to students who receive an average score of at least 3.5 on all AP Exams taken, and scores of 3 or higher on five or more of these exams.
